name: Le Sims
description: A well-known restaurant in Bastos offering Cameroonian and international cuisine, including grilled meats, seafood, traditional dishes and varied European-inspired meals.
bonASavoir: The restaurant offers both gastronomy and fast food. Popular dishes include grilled chicken, prawns, sole, ndolé and chicken basquaise. Prices start around 3,000 FCFA depending on the dish.
